plugins.name: blitzreels
plugins.description: Create short clips, edit videos, add captions, build carousels, and export with BlitzReels.

skills.name: blitzreels-carousels
skills.description: Create still-slide carousels with BlitzReels. Use for multi-image posts, photo mode, or swipe decks.
skills.description_zh: 使用 BlitzReels 创建由静态幻灯片组成的轮播，适用于多图帖子、照片模式或可滑动演示。

skills.name: blitzreels-clipping
skills.description: Create, select, reframe, repair, caption, or export short clips from long-form media, including supported YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Google Drive, and direct video URLs.
skills.description_zh: 使用 BlitzReels 从长视频创建、选择、重构画幅、修复、加字幕或导出短片，支持指定的 YouTube、Instagram、TikTok、X、Facebook、Google Drive 及直接视频链接。

skills.name: blitzreels-editing
skills.description: Edit BlitzReels projects through CLI or REST. Use for timeline, caption, media, preview, or export changes.
skills.description_zh: 通过 CLI 或 REST 编辑 BlitzReels 项目，修改时间线、字幕、媒体、预览或导出配置。

skills.name: blitzreels-generation
skills.description: Generate AI media with BlitzReels. Use for faceless videos, paced Seedance I2V ads, images, clips, voiceovers, music, SFX, or authored briefs.
skills.description_zh: 使用 BlitzReels 按创作简报生成 AI 媒体，包括无露脸视频、控制节奏的 Seedance 图生视频广告、图片、短片、配音、音乐和音效。

skills.name: blitzreels-x-video
skills.description: Turn an X or Twitter post, native X video, thread, conversation, or current trend into short-form video with BlitzReels. Use when the user provides an x.com URL or asks to research X and create clips, a faceless explainer, a trend response, or platform-ready video.
headings: Create a video from an X discussion
skills.description_zh: 将 X/Twitter 帖子、原生视频、线程、对话或当下趋势转成 BlitzReels 短视频，适用于 x.com 链接或研究 X 后制作剪辑、无露脸解释、趋势回应和平台成片。
